# Global and local Measures of Spatial Autocorrelation

## Import libraries


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf,sfdep,tmap,tidyverse)
```
:::


## The Data - Importing 'Hunan' table


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
 hunan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
 hunan_2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


## Joining Hunan and Hunan_2012


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_GDPPC <- left_join(hunan_sf, hunan_2012) %>% select(1:4, 7, 15)
```
:::


## Visualising geographically weighted summary statistics


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(hunan_GDPPC) + tm_fill("GDPPC", 
          n = 5, 
          style = "quantile") + 
  tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) + 
  tm_layout(main.title = "Distribution of geographically weighted mean", 
            main.title.position = "center", 
            main.title.size = 1.8, 
            legend.text.size = 1.2, 
            legend.height = 1.50, 
            legend.width = 1.50, 
            frame = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex05_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


## Deriving Queen's contiguity weights: sfdep methods


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
wm_q <- hunan_GDPPC %>% mutate(nb = st_contiguity(geometry), wt = st_weights(nb, style = "W"), .before = 1)
```
:::


## Performing Global Moran'I permutation test


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
global_moran_perm(wm_q$GDPPC,
                  wm_q$nb, wm_q$wt, nsim=99)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

